question: Should this broad Control UI composer/model-picker redesign land as the maintained direction now that the prior Talk-label i18n cleanup is fixed?
rationale: The remaining uncertainty is not a mechanical bug fix; it is whether the current composer layout, picker behavior, and proof gaps are acceptable for a protected user-facing surface.

options.title: Land After Acceptance
options.body: Accept the current design after maintainer visual/product review and merge once required current-head checks are green.

options.title: Request Fresh Web UI Proof
options.body: Ask for a current-head web UI chat proof pass before deciding whether the visual and interaction evidence is enough.

options.title: Split Or Pause
options.body: Hold this branch if maintainers want the model-picker, voice, message-action, or IME fixes separated from the broad redesign.

recommendation.title: Land After Acceptance
recommendation.body: Accept the current design after maintainer visual/product review and merge once required current-head checks are green.
